description: Two distinct flagged occurrences over one projected span each contribute weight (engine §7.10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution leftmost-longest #(·w ∪ ·d ∪ ·c ∪ ·inner), late #·_<_Elided>
%elision-only
%rule text (w ≻ missing) | d | c
%rule w (X [+T]) | ([+U] X)
               
%rule missing (M N)
%rule d (X T)
               
%rule c (inner T)
               
%rule inner X
